# Test fixtures

`bge_small_ref_st.json` holds reference embeddings: one vector per sentence in `bge_small_sentences.json`, recorded from [`BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5`](https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5) (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2022 staoxiao; full text in [`crates/core/testdata/README.md`](../../../core/testdata/README.md)) with sentence-transformers 6.1.0 and torch 2.14.1 on the CPU, CLS pooling, L2-normalised, maximum sequence length 512. They were made by `spikes/native-stack/test11/reference.py ref`; the two files are byte-identical to `ref_st.json` and `sentences.json` in that folder. The tests in `local_cpu.rs` and `local_dml.rs` check that Selene Retrieval's own embeddings match these vectors. `providers/` holds recorded response shapes for the provider contract tests (`remote_contract.rs`).
